query: When primary mixed-effects logistic models fail to converge, what pre-registered contingency sequence should we follow (e.g., remove random slopes, use Bayesian hierarchical models with weak priors, or switch to GEE with cluster-robust SEs)?

response.query: When primary mixed-effects logistic models fail to converge, what pre-registered contingency sequence should we follow (e.g., remove random slopes, use Bayesian hierarchical models with weak priors, or switch to GEE with cluster-robust SEs)?
response.answer: When primary mixed-effects logistic models fail to converge, consider removing random slopes or switching to GEE with cluster-robust SEs. Bayesian hierarchical models with weak priors can also be an alternative.
